units.source_text: 源氏公子派惟光前来问候。

en.t: Prince Genji sent Koremitsu to pay his respects.

units.source_text: 惟光转述公子的话道：“我本当亲自前来问候，只因父皇宣召，未能如愿。

en.t: Koremitsu conveyed the prince's message: "I had meant to come in person to ask after you, but His Majesty my father summoned me, and I could not do as I wished.

units.source_text: 但每逢想起凄凉之状，不胜痛心。”

en.t: Yet whenever I think of your desolate state, my heart aches beyond measure."

units.source_text: 又命惟光带几个人来值宿。

en.t: He also ordered Koremitsu to bring several men and keep night watch there.

units.source_text: 少纳言乳母说：“这太不成话了！

en.t: The nurse Shonagon said, "This is completely unacceptable!

units.source_text: 虽然他们在一起睡只是形式而已，可是一开始就如此怠慢，也太荒唐了。

en.t: Even if sleeping together is only a formality, to be so negligent from the very beginning is far too outrageous.

units.source_text: 倘被兵部卿大人得知，定将责备我们看护人太不周到呢！

en.t: If His Excellency the Minister of War were to learn of it, he would surely blame us attendants for being terribly careless!
My young lady, you must be careful!

units.source_text: 爸爸面前切勿谈起源氏公子的事！”

en.t: You must never mention Prince Genji in front of your father!"

units.source_text: 然而紫儿全然不懂这话的意思，真是天可怜见！

en.t: But little Murasaki did not understand what these words meant at all, which was truly pitiful.

units.source_text: 少纳言乳母便把紫儿的悲苦身世讲给惟光听，后来又说：“再过些时光，如果真有宿缘，定当成就好事。

en.t: The nurse Shonagon then told Koremitsu the sad story of Murasaki's life, and later added, "After some time has passed, if there is truly a destined bond, it will surely come to a good end.

units.source_text: 只是目前实在太不相称；公子如此想念她，真不知出于何心，我百思不得其解，心中好生烦恼！

en.t: But at present it is far too unsuitable; why the prince longs for her so much, I truly cannot understand, no matter how I think about it, and it troubles me deeply.

units.source_text: 今天兵部卿大人又来过了，他对我说：‘你要好好地照顾她，千万不可轻举妄为！’

en.t: Today His Excellency the Minister of War came again, and he said to me, 'Take good care of her, and on no account act rashly!'

units.source_text: 经他这么一嘱咐，我对源氏公子这种想入非非的行径，也就觉得更加为难了。”

en.t: After he gave me that warning, I found Prince Genji's fanciful behavior even harder to deal with."

units.source_text: 说到这里，她忽然想起：如果说得太过分了，深恐惟光竟会疑心公子和姑娘之间已经有了事实关系，倒是使不得的。

en.t: At this point, she suddenly realized that if she said too much, Koremitsu might suspect that something had already happened between the prince and the girl, and that would never do.

units.source_text: 因此她不再那么哀叹了。

en.t: So she stopped lamenting so intensely.

units.source_text: 惟光确也莫名其妙，不知二人之间究竟是怎么回事。

en.t: Koremitsu, too, was genuinely bewildered and had no idea what was really going on between the two of them.
